summary: Re-scoped to the 8-item acceptance_matrix from the latest briefing. 39 backend tests across 12 files (all passed; 3 live-Gemini-dependent tests were flaky on first run and passed on rerun, 1 known race-condition test is itself flaky by design) and 8 new browser checks, one per UI-facing criterion (all passed). All 8 criteria exercised with both backend and browser evidence where the criterion is API-backed.

bugs.criterion: Tax Compliance workspace sync + validation + export
bugs.title: GET /api/auditpro/tax/documents and /tax/summary occasionally 500 due to a pre-existing TOCTOU race in sync_sources() (routers/tax.py)
bugs.description: Reconfirmed from prior iteration: the find_one-then-insert_one pattern for creating a tax document per (source_type, source_id) is not atomic. During this iteration's own tax-workflow browser check, the frontend's own refetch-after-sync pattern (POST /tax/sync followed by near-simultaneous GET /tax/summary and GET /tax/documents) triggered a live 500: 'pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError: E11000 duplicate key error ... index: tax_source'. The check itself passed on rerun once the in-flight race had resolved, but the underlying bug is unfixed.
bugs.evidence: Backend log during browser check 'tax-compliance-sync-and-workflow' (first attempt): GET /api/auditpro/tax/summary -> 500 Internal Server Error, with pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError on collection auditpro.audit_tax_documents, index tax_source, dup key {source_type: 'invoice', source_id: '...'}. Also reproducible deterministically via backend test tests/test_tscheck_tax_sync_race_condition.py (6 concurrent GETs after an approval -> at least one 500 in most runs).

action_items.note: tests/test_tscheck_document_extraction.py, test_tscheck_document_validation.py, and test_tscheck_duplicate_detection.py each call the LIVE Gemini 3.8 Flash OCR endpoint and intermittently return 502 'Gemini tidak dapat memproses dokumen ini' on the first attempt, then pass cleanly on an immediate rerun with no code change. Matches spec_deviations (live LLM latency/availability). Not classified as a bug per instructions; recorded for visibility only.

The tax/sync race condition bug (see bugs[]) was already reported in a prior iteration (iteration_3) and remains unresolved. Tracked here again because this iteration's browser check for the Tax Compliance criterion hit it live.

checks.criterion: Dashboard (Overview) loads and shows finance metrics
checks.name: dashboard-overview-renders
checks.evidence: Navigated to '/', metric-total-revenue-value/metric-cashflow-value/metric-receivables-value/metric-audit-rate-value all visible with non-zero Rp values (receivables != 'Rp0'), revenue-chart and recent-invoices-table render with >0 rows. Also reran against the public preview URL https://auditpro-39.preview.emergentagent.com — passed.

checks.criterion: Transaksi approval state machine with audit trail
checks.name: transaction-approval-audit-trail
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-approval-<ts> expense transaction via UI -> submit (draft->review) -> approve (review->approved, badge 'Disetujui' visible) -> opened row -> transaction-audit-content and audit-event-action-0 visible.

checks.criterion: Transaksi approval state machine with audit trail
checks.name: test_tscheck_transaction_approval_audit.py
checks.evidence: draft->submit(200,review)->approve(200,approved) with audit_trail containing submitted+approved entries; draft->submit->reject(200,rejected) with note preserved; draft->approve directly rejected with 409.

checks.name: invoice-studio-create-and-pay
checks.evidence: Selected a seeded customer+product in InvoiceStudio, live preview showed non-zero subtotal/tax/total/terbilang, saved draft -> invoice-export-card with auto-generated number appeared, send (draft->sent) then mark_paid (sent->paid) -> 'Lunas' badge visible.

checks.name: test_tscheck_invoice_payment_workflow.py
checks.evidence: POST invoice -> send (200,sent) -> mark_paid (200,paid,paid_at set) -> GET /transactions shows a matching approved income transaction with total == invoice.total; mark_paid directly from draft -> 409.

checks.name: invoice-export-pdf-excel
checks.evidence: Created a fresh invoice, clicked invoice-export-pdf-button and invoice-export-excel-button; Playwright download events captured with filenames matching .pdf and .xlsx.

checks.name: test_tscheck_invoice_export.py
checks.evidence: GET /auditpro/invoices/{id}/export.pdf -> 200, content-type pdf, body starts with %PDF; export.xlsx -> 200, zip/office content-type, body starts with PK; both exports on a random nonexistent id -> 404.

checks.criterion: Tax Compliance workspace sync + validation + export
checks.name: tax-compliance-sync-and-workflow
checks.evidence: Created+approved a fresh tscheck-tax-<ts> expense, clicked tax-sync-button, located the synced tax-document row, filled NPWP + invoice number, saved validation, then drove Draft->Review->Ready->Reported; tax-status-reported badge visible on that row; tax-output-card-value/tax-input-card-value visible. First attempt hit a live 500 from the pre-existing sync race condition (see bugs[]); passed cleanly on rerun.

checks.criterion: Tax Compliance workspace sync + validation + export
checks.name: test_tscheck_tax_workflow.py / test_tscheck_tax_dashboard_summary.py / test_tscheck_tax_exports.py / test_tscheck_tax_sync_idempotent.py / test_tscheck_tax_validation_completeness.py / test_tscheck_tax_rate_profile.py / test_tscheck_tax_correction_on_edit.py
checks.evidence: Full tax lifecycle (draft->review->ready->reported, needs_correction path), summary DPP/PPN per 0/11/12% profile, CSV/XLSX/e-Faktur exports all 200 with correct content-type/signature, idempotent re-sync (no duplicate docs on second sync call) all pass.

checks.criterion: Tax Compliance workspace sync + validation + export
checks.name: test_tscheck_tax_sync_race_condition.py
checks.evidence: 6 concurrent GET /auditpro/tax/documents after approving a fresh transaction -> statuses observed [500,200,200,200,500,200] / [200,200,500,200,200,200] across runs; pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError on unique (source_type, source_id) index in sync_sources(). Reproducible; carried forward from iteration_3 as an unresolved bug.

checks.name: reports-summary-and-export
checks.evidence: report-sales-value/report-expense-value/report-profit-value/report-receivables-value/report-tax-collected all visible with real figures; clicking report-export-csv-button triggers a download with a .csv filename.

checks.name: test_tscheck_reports_summary_export.py
checks.evidence: GET /auditpro/reports/summary -> 200 with sales_total/expense_total/net_profit/receivables/tax_collected/tax_paid and net_profit == sales_total - expense_total; GET /auditpro/reports/export.csv -> 200, text/csv, attachment disposition, non-empty body.

checks.name: documents-vault-list-and-validate
checks.evidence: document-vault-table renders with >0 rows; selected a pending tscheck-prefixed document row, clicked validate-document-button (submit then approve as needed), validated-state ('sudah tervalidasi') became visible.

checks.name: test_tscheck_document_validation.py
checks.evidence: Fails intermittently on the live Gemini OCR call with 502 'Gemini tidak dapat memproses dokumen ini'; passes cleanly on immediate rerun with no code change (2/2 and then 5/5 on full-suite rerun). Per spec_deviations this is live-LLM latency, not an app bug.

checks.name: assistant-session-chat-and-proposal
checks.evidence: Created a new assistant session, sent a grounded question, assistant-empty-state disappeared and at least one assistant-message-* appeared (streamed response persisted to session history).

checks.criterion: AI Assistant session + grounded streaming + proposal confirmation
checks.name: test_tscheck_assistant_proposal_flow.py
checks.evidence: POST session -> SSE stream contains meta/delta/done events with a grounded answer; a report-drafting prompt yields a 'proposal' SSE event (status=pending) and an audit 'proposal_created' entry; POST .../decision {confirm:true} -> status=confirmed with result_id set and audit 'proposal_confirmed'; {confirm:false} on a separate proposal -> status=cancelled, result_id=null (no draft created).
